name: SignInGoogleButton
description: One-click Google OAuth sign-in trigger. Defaults to a full-page redirect to `${oauthBaseUrl}/oauth/google`, the Gateway's Google sign-in route

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a spinner instead of the content and disable the button

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Make the button stretch to fill its container

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Class names applied to the inner content wrapper

props.name: oauthBaseUrl
props.description: Base URL of the OAuth backend (no trailing slash). Click navigates to `${oauthBaseUrl}/oauth/google`

props.name: onClick
props.description: Override the click behaviour entirely. When set, `oauthBaseUrl` is ignored
